 ORDER
This is first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 16-01-2023 in connection with Crime No.21 of 2023 registered at police station Narwar, District Shivpuri for offence under Sections 342, 376(3), 120-B of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

According to prosecution case, on 13-01-2023, the prosecutrix who is aged about 15 years lodged a Bhupendra Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124322808/
1 written complainant at police station Narwar, District Shivpuri alleging therein that she is studying in Class-X. On the date of incident i.e. 13-01-2023 at around 05:00 pm when she had gone for fetching water from the hand-pump, at that time accused Ramesh Kushwah of her village and his another relative present applicant Bhupendra, both came near hand pump.

sentences.text: Near the hand-pump, a Kothi (small room) is situated and present applicant Bhupendra took her inside the said Kothi and committed sexual intercourse with her at there and co-accused Ramesh was keeping a wath on the gate of said Kothi.
On seeing the villagers, both of them fled away from the place of incident.
On the basis of such written complaint, FIR vide Crime No. 21 of 2023 was registered on 14-01-2023 and the prosecutrix was sent for medical examination.
As per medical report, no sign of recent injury as well as no sign of forced penetrate-sex was found on the body of the prosecutrix.
The applicant- accused was arrested.
After completion of investigation and other formalities, charge sheet has been filed.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case.
He is in custody since 16-01-2023.
Charge sheet has been filed.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
There is no possibility of his absconding or tampering with the prosecution case.
Co-accused Ramesh Kushwah has been extended benefit of bail by this Court by order dated 20.02.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.7314/2023.
Hence, prayed for grant of bail.
Learned counsel for the State as well as learned counsel for the complainant vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Both the Advocates are heard.
Case diary perused.

Looking to the facts & circumstances of the case, without commenting upon merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes cash surety of Rs.25,000/- alongwith bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of default, cash surety of Rs. 25,000/- shall stand forfeited automatically.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
